CHEAP.eviction_rule: evict the candidate with the highest leaf rank; ties: larger F01 (LRU), then layer ascending, then expert ascending
CHEAP.export: nested integer comparisons; each leaf stores an integer leaf rank = position of its mean y in ascending order over leaves (ties by node id); no floating point at decision time
CHEAP.four_feature_procedure: fit on all 16 features; if more than 4 distinct features are used, rank features by total SSE reduction in that tree (ties: lower index), keep the top 4, refit on those 4 with the same settings. TRAIN only.
CHEAP.leaf_support_rule: a split is admissible only if each child holds >= 1000 rows drawn from >= 50 distinct sampled decisions
CHEAP.split_search: exhaustive over integer thresholds t (left branch: x <= t); maximize SSE reduction; ties: lower feature index in feature_order, then lower t
CHEAP.stop: a node is a leaf if depth = 3, if no split leaves >= min_samples_leaf rows on both sides, or if the best SSE reduction is <= 0

RICH.binning: per feature, edges = distinct values if <= 255, else the 255 quantile cut points of TRAIN rows (numpy.quantile, method='lower'); bins fixed from TRAIN
RICH.class: gradient-boosted regression trees (single configuration, numpy implementation)
RICH.determinism: pure numpy, single thread; numpy version and SHA-256 of the fitted model recorded in the Phase 1 lock
RICH.eviction_rule: predictions are quantized to integers round(pred * 2^16) before ranking; evict the maximum; ties: larger F01, then layer ascending, then expert ascending
RICH.role: diagnostic information ceiling of the frozen feature vocabulary; NOT a runtime candidate; inference cost ignored
RICH.split_ties: lower feature index, then lower bin

teacher.decision_unit: each eviction required while admitting one missed expert; several evictions of one event are separate decisions in sequence
teacher.distance: d = nu_j(k) - j, nu from argine.research.oracle.next_uses over the served event list; never used again => inf
teacher.no_future_in_policy: targets never enter features; the deployed policies see only FEATURE_CONTRACT inputs
teacher.sampling: eviction decisions of the A trajectory are numbered 0, 1, 2, ... per TRAIN trace over all served events (prefill included); decisions with index mod 64 == 0 are sampled; all candidates of a sampled decision are rows; total decisions and rows are reported
teacher.shift_diagnostic: non-gating: on TRAIN, report agreement of CHEAP's victim with the teacher victim under A's states and under CHEAP's own states
teacher.target: y = log2(1 + d) for finite d; y = 21.0 for d = inf. Phase 1 asserts that every trace has fewer than 2^20 served events, so every finite y < 20 < 21.
teacher.teacher_victim: argmax d over candidates (Belady rule); used only for diagnostics
teacher.trajectory: TRAIN labels come from the A (b_selected) replay state trajectory on each TRAIN trace (the frozen reference policy); the learned policies are evaluated under their own cache state.

validation_use: VALIDATION scores the TRAIN-fitted CHEAP and RICH once; there are no alternatives to select between.
